Definition: Jozabad, the name of ten Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jozabad is named 9 times in the Bible, and the passages here are 1 Chronicles 12:20; 2 Chronicles 31:13; Ezra 8:33. In 1 Chronicles 12:20 we read, "As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and Ezra 8:33 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Jozabad was counted by God, and what moves me is that the name is still here. The Bible does not waste names, and neither does God.
RelatedPeople: Jozabad, Captain of Manasseh; Jozabad, Overseer; Jozabad the Levite
